mechanism: Loperamide may increase intestinal transit time and delay primaquine absorption, reducing antimalarial efficacy, while primaquine's hemolytic effects in G6PD-deficient patients could theoretically be exacerbated by loperamide-induced gut stasis.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, separate administration times by at least 2-4 hours and monitor for adequate primaquine efficacy and hemolytic complications.
